lines.text: Line eighty-one: motor accel takes a wheel speed and returns the acceleration the four motors can still add.
Line eighty-two: over the wheel radius, times the gear ratio, gives the motor's speed. About five hundred thirty radians per second.
Line eighty-three: get current uses twelve volts and the back E M F: fifty-nine point eight amps. Math dot min caps it at one hundred fifty.
Line eighty-four: get torque turns amps into newton meters. Times gear ratio, over wheel radius: one hundred fifty-seven point four newtons at the tire.
Math dot max with zero matters past top speed, where the current would go negative.
Line eighty-five: four wheels times that force, over the mass. F equals m a, turned around. Ten point four nine.
Who calls limit? Exactly one line: Drive To Pose, line one ninety-seven.
Drive To Pose passes in the velocity it wants, and, as current, last loop's command. So each command is a small step from the last.
Line one fifty-two seeds it with the measured velocity when Drive To Pose starts, so the first step starts from reality.
Line one sixty-one measures d t each loop, about zero point zero two seconds.
Line one ninety-nine sends the result to the drivetrain. Fifty times a second, one small, safe step at a time.
